Bulletproof vs VEXI: Which Is Better for Realtors in 2026?
Bulletproof and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare Bulletproof vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI for done-for-you social media.

Bulletproof helps real estate agents get found by home sellers on Google and AI search [1]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two do different jobs, and in many ways they fit together.

Bulletproof (BulletProof Real Estate Agent) describes itself as a real estate technology company, established in 2022, that helps agents get found on Google and AI search and turns that visibility into calls from home sellers [1][4]. It works with real estate agents only [4]. Bulletproof’s four plans run from $399 to $3,999 a month and combine Google Business Profile management, SEO, AI-search visibility, review growth, a CRM and group coaching, with an IDX website from the Pro plan up [2].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two do different main jobs. Here is what each one does.

Bulletproof’s Flagship plan covers Google Business Profile management, SEO, 50+ authority profiles, AI-search visibility and a review growth system [2]. Its Pro and higher plans add an IDX website, home valuation capture and automated lead follow-up [2].

Bulletproof lists Flagship at $399 a month, Pro at $999, Premium at $1,250 and Platinum at $3,999, with yearly billing saving one month [2]. Its terms set a fixed 12-month term that renews for another 12 months unless you give written notice at least 30 days before it ends [3].
Bulletproof’s terms list social media posts among its services, with business listings and reputation monitoring [3]. Its Premium and Platinum plans add managed Meta ads [2].

Every Bulletproof plan includes three weekly group coaching calls and Watson Powers coaching twice a month [2]. Its Premium plan adds a U.S.-based VIP Success Manager, with seven weekly launch meetings and then monthly strategy sessions [2].
